top_signals.title: Japan Preempts Market With Yen Intervention
top_signals.summary: Japan intervened in the currency market to bolster the yen, which sharply advanced as much as 3.3% versus the dollar in New York trading on Thursday. Bloomberg's Shery Ahn breaks down the developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rally as Korea Surges, Yen Pares Gain: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rallied after South Korean equities posted a record intraday gain, as investors renewed bets on the artificial intelligence trade following this week’s rout. The yen weakened, giving back some of Thursday’s intervention-driven gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. and China discuss trade and rare earths in call ahead of Xi visit
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he held a call Thursday with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to lay the groundwork for President Xi Jinping's U.S. visit in September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Four women and three men are so far in the running to succeed U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who will complete his second five-year term on Dec. 31.
